linuxserver.name: CasaOS-LinuxServer-AppStore
linuxserver.summary: A home for LinuxServer.io images, ready for your CasaOS.
linuxserver.description: A custom CasaOS app store described by its contributor as containing over 100 LinuxServer.io images. Explore a broad collection of applications for your personal cloud.

appstore-play.name: CasaOS-AppStore-Play
appstore-play.summary: Local Chinese favorites, with a dedicated ARMv7 source.
appstore-play.description: A not-so-serious app store focused on local Chinese applications, including Thunder, Qinglong, and VerySync. Applications use the :latest tag. A separate source is available for Raspberry Pi 2, OneCloud, and other ARMv7 devices.

coolstore.name: CasaOS-Coolstore
coolstore.summary: A fresh collection of cool apps for your personal cloud.
coolstore.description: Another community-built CasaOS app store, bringing together a collection of cool applications to explore on your device.

edge.name: CasaOS (Edge) AppStore
edge.summary: A community fork of the official store with updated versions.
edge.description: A fork of the official CasaOS app store that offers updated application versions. This community project is maintained independently of the official store.

home-automation.name: CasaOS HomeAutomation AppStore
home-automation.summary: Useful tools for a more connected home, and a little more.
home-automation.description: A CasaOS app store containing useful applications for home automation and other tasks. Bring more of your connected home tools together on your own device.

big-bear.name: Big Bear CasaOS App Store
big-bear.summary: A community app collection from Big Bear and friends.
big-bear.description: The Big Bear CasaOS App Store is maintained by BigBearTechWorld and the BigBearCommunity. It is a community app store and is not maintained by the CasaOS team.

tmc.name: TMC Community App Store
tmc.summary: A community-driven collection, open to your contributions.
tmc.description: An independent, community-driven app store curated by TMC (mariosemes), open to contributions from anyone. Explore the applications brought together by its community.

pentest-docker.name: CasaOS Pentest-Docker AppStore
pentest-docker.summary: A dedicated collection of penetration testing tools.
pentest-docker.description: Pentest-Docker is a third-party CasaOS app store containing penetration testing tool applications.

generative-ai-workbench.name: JSDs Generative AI Workbench
generative-ai-workbench.summary: An AI workbench for digital artisans and creative studios.
generative-ai-workbench.description: The Foundry Workbench brings together applications, tools, and ready-to-use solutions for digital artisans and studios to concept, design, develop, create, and publish digital projects. Despite the ZimaOS repository name, the original listing describes support for CasaOS when suitable GPUs are available.
